card.name: Right before a drug name in labels
card.fires_on: The small word or first letter just before a drug name is spelled out, such as 'of', 'in' or 'with' after 'dosage', 'moiety' or 'treatment'. It also fires on the first capital letter of an all-caps brand name.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: A short word like of, in or with that comes right before a drug name.
modes.example: the recommended dosage<< of>> mesalamine delayed-release capsules is

modes.label: Start of capitalized brand name
modes.description: The first capital letter of an all-caps brand or drug name, with the rest of the name in later pieces.

card.plain: It fires at the spot where a drug name is about to appear in a label, especially after words like dosage, treatment or active moiety.
